Theorem
1. Theorem 1.22\group harmonic-functions Source: han-lin-lecture-notes:page-0017 For $x,y\in B_R$ the Green function is \[ G(x,y)=\begin{cases} [(2-n)\omega _n]^{-1}\left(|x-y|^{2-n}-\left|\frac R{|x|}x-\frac{|x|}{R}y\right|^{2-n}\right),& n\ge 3,\\ (2\pi )^{-1}\left(\log |x-y|-\log \left|\frac R{|x|}x-\frac{|x|}{R}y\right|\right),& n=2. \end{cases} \]
Proof

\sketch Invert $x$ through $\partial B_R$ at $X=R^2x/|x|^2$. For $|y|=R$, $|y-x|=(|x|/R)|y-X|$, so the displayed reflected singularity cancels the boundary value while leaving the pole at $x$.

□
